title: MulmoTerminal — one launch form, beside what you are looking at
description: Short feature clip. Starting the next agent no longer takes you away: the launch form opens beside your current view, and the new session joins the grid while you stay where you are. Slides are English in both language versions.

beats.text: Starting the next session is easier now. The launch form opens beside your current view. Pick a directory, and the next agent starts right there.
